product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Universal Mic Clip for Handheld Microphones 5-Pack
product.description: Stage Right™ microphone clips are specifically designed to securely hold most common handheld microphones. The fit is firm (25mm width), ensuring your microphone stays in place while on stage.
